summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running tests, black, or flake8 (read-only verification only). Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private _resolve_path; explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, TemporaryDirectory cleanup, platform-neutral expected paths). Beyond the spec I added ValueError checks for a non-list value under the data_list_key and a non-object top-level JSON. Measured line lengths: no line in the new files exceeds 120 columns (max 119). Nothing was committed.
